Per chip GHG emissions were up in 2012, largely driven by decreased production at the end of the year. Absolute emis-
sions were only slightly up from 2011 levels, and we increased our annual purchase commitment of renewable energy 
credits to 100% of our U.S. electricity use. We remain on track to meet our goal.
Reducing water use continued to be a challenge, and increased on both a per chip and absolute basis from 2011 to 2012. 
However, we completed water conservation pilots and have initiated design projects that will help us meet our goal by 2020.
We continued to invest in energy conservation projects during 2012, investing $30 million and achieving energy savings 
of 117 million kWh. Taking into account other planned investments, we are on track to reach our goal.
